title: Advanced Battery Management System for Electric Vehicles
abstract: A novel battery management system for electric vehicles that optimizes charging cycles and extends battery life through intelligent thermal management and state-of-charge monitoring.
description: The invention relates to a battery management system (BMS) for electric vehicles that incorporates advanced thermal management and state-of-charge monitoring. The system includes multiple temperature sensors distributed throughout the battery pack, a central processing unit that analyzes temperature data in real-time, and adaptive cooling mechanisms that respond to thermal conditions. The BMS also features an innovative state-of-charge algorithm that accounts for battery aging and environmental conditions to provide more accurate range estimates.
claims: 1. A battery management system for electric vehicles comprising: a plurality of temperature sensors distributed throughout a battery pack; a central processing unit configured to analyze temperature data in real-time; and an adaptive cooling system responsive to thermal conditions. 2. The system of claim 1, further comprising a state-of-charge monitoring algorithm that accounts for battery aging. 3. The system of claim 1, wherein the adaptive cooling system includes liquid cooling channels and variable-speed fans.

title: Fast Charging System for Electric Vehicle Batteries
abstract: An innovative fast-charging system that reduces charging time while maintaining battery health through optimized charging protocols and thermal management.
description: This invention describes a fast-charging system specifically designed for electric vehicle batteries. The system implements a multi-stage charging protocol that adjusts charging rates based on battery temperature, state of charge, and historical usage patterns. The charging system includes an advanced thermal management subsystem that pre-cools the battery before charging and maintains optimal temperature during the charging process. The invention also features a predictive algorithm that estimates the optimal charging time based on current battery conditions and desired charge level.
claims: 1. A fast-charging system for electric vehicle batteries comprising: a multi-stage charging protocol; a thermal management subsystem; and a predictive charging algorithm. 2. The system of claim 1, wherein the multi-stage charging protocol adjusts charging rates based on battery temperature and state of charge. 3. The system of claim 1, further comprising a pre-cooling mechanism that conditions the battery before charging.

title: Modular Battery Pack Design for Electric Vehicles
abstract: A modular battery pack design that enables easy replacement of individual battery modules and improves overall vehicle serviceability.
description: The present invention relates to a modular battery pack design for electric vehicles. The design features individual battery modules that can be independently replaced, reducing maintenance costs and improving vehicle uptime. Each module includes its own monitoring and control circuitry, allowing for precise state-of-health tracking. The modular design also facilitates battery pack customization for different vehicle models and enables easier recycling of battery components at end-of-life.
claims: 1. A modular battery pack for electric vehicles comprising: a plurality of independently replaceable battery modules; individual monitoring circuitry for each module; and a standardized connection interface. 2. The battery pack of claim 1, wherein each module includes state-of-health monitoring capabilities. 3. The battery pack of claim 1, further comprising a thermal isolation system between modules.

title: In-Situ Pipe Laying System with Resin-Impregnated Reinforcement
abstract: A novel pipe laying system using resin-impregnated reinforcement for in-situ pipe installation and repair.
description: The invention relates to a process and plant for laying pipes in trenches using a flattened tubular preform with resin-impregnated reinforcement. The system includes a specialized preform with an inner seal and outer reinforcement layer. The reinforcement is pre-impregnated with a thermosetting resin that cures upon inflation. The process involves placing the flattened preform in the trench, inflating it to the desired shape, and allowing the resin to cure, creating a strong, durable pipe in place.
claims: 1. A process for laying a pipe in a trench comprising: placing a flattened tubular preform in the trench, the preform having a reinforcement surrounding an inner seal, the reinforcement being impregnated with a resin; and inflating the preform in the trench. 2. The process of claim 1, wherein the reinforcement comprises fiberglass or carbon fiber. 3. The process of claim 1, wherein the resin is a thermosetting resin that cures upon heating.

title: Advanced Pipe Rehabilitation System
abstract: An innovative system for rehabilitating existing pipelines using resin-impregnated liners and robotic installation.
description: This invention describes a comprehensive system for rehabilitating existing pipelines without excavation. The system uses a robotic installation device that places a resin-impregnated liner inside the existing pipe. The liner is then inflated and cured in place, creating a new pipe within the old one. The system includes advanced monitoring capabilities to ensure proper installation and curing of the liner.
claims: 1. A pipe rehabilitation system comprising: a robotic installation device; a resin-impregnated liner; and a curing system. 2. The system of claim 1, wherein the robotic installation device includes sensors for monitoring installation parameters. 3. The system of claim 1, further comprising a UV curing system for hardening the resin.
